payload.rationale: Apply minimal, schema-safe edits to clear hard-gate failures: (1) remove architecture option free-text /risks fields that are being validated as unresolved ID references, (2) null invalid decision_log evidence pointer entity_id values for branch_set references, and (3) populate required risk closure for critical K8 (plus fill K6 mitigation). Also resolve sequencing inconsistencies by adjusting milestone exit-criteria wording and a SHOULD performance target gate to a measure-and-mitigate criterion.

value.text: Implement a mandatory build-time privacy guard that excludes notes marked private (e.g., front matter publish:false or configurable equivalent) from all emitted artifacts, including rendered pages and the search index; add tests to ensure no private content is emitted.

Parse YAML front matter defensively: on malformed front matter, skip front-matter fields for that file, emit a build warning with file path and parse error, and continue the build (do not crash the entire build by default). Add fixtures covering common YAML errors.

patch.value: AT4 passes: headings, lists, emphasis, links, images, code blocks render correctly (AT3 is deferred to M6 end-to-end validation when exclusion patterns are implemented).

Performance target (R22): measure and report search query latency for a 1,000-note fixture; if >500 ms, document findings and implement/plan mitigations (e.g., index chunking/lazy load) rather than blocking milestone completion by default.

Build-time privacy guard: mandatory check that prevents emission of notes marked as private (front-matter field 'publish: false' or configurable equivalent) from all outputs, including rendered pages and derived artifacts such as the search index, mitigating K8.
